build_MetaQuery_model: build a MetaQuery model from a MetaQueryConfig to generate images from text captions
create_MetaQueryConfig: create a MetaQueryConfig with custom vae_id, input_size, loss_type, and num_metaqueries parameters
run_forward_training: run the MetaQuery forward pass with target images and input_ids to compute flow or diff loss
sample_images_from_caption: sample images from a text caption using MetaQuery sample_images with guidance scale and inference steps
decode_latents_to_images: decode latent tensors back to PIL images using MetaQuery decode_latents with normalization
